title: God of War Sons of Sparta hits PS4 on November 16 ⚔️

description:
Will you try Hermes Mode or Erebus Mode? 👇

God of War: Sons of Sparta, the 2D spin-off from Mega Cat Studios and Santa Monica Studio, launches on PS4 on November 16 with a patch that adds Hermes Mode and Erebus Mode on PS4 and PS5.

Sources: Video Games Chronicle (Nov 13, 2026)
Game images © Sony Interactive Entertainment.

scenes.text: Young Kratos is coming to PS4 on November 16.
scenes.image: God of War Sons of Sparta

scenes.text: Sons of Sparta, the 2D spin-off from Mega Cat Studios and Santa Monica Studio, came out on PS5 in February.
It's canon, set during Kratos' training at the Agoge with his brother Deimos.
A patch the same day adds two modes on PS4 and PS5.
Hermes Mode gives speedrunners a split timer and a scoreboard. A start-menu code opens it early.
In Erebus Mode, one hit kills you, and one hit kills every enemy.
